name: MariaDB Galera Cluster
description: Multi-master MariaDB Galera Cluster node. Create one "first node" to start a cluster, then create additional nodes that join it automatically.

items.text: First node - create a new cluster
Additional node - join an existing cluster

editor.label: Node role
editor.description: Pick "First node" for the very first node of a brand new cluster. Every node after that is an additional node.
editor.requiredMessage: Choose whether this node starts a new cluster or joins an existing one.

editor.label: Cluster name
editor.description: Must be identical on every node of the same cluster. Also used to find the other nodes automatically.

editor.label: Existing node address(es) - optional
editor.description: Leave blank to find the other nodes of this cluster automatically. Only fill this in to join a cluster this panel does not own, as ip:port, comma separated.

editor.label: Cluster root password - optional
editor.description: Leave blank to inherit the root password from the existing node automatically.

editor.label: InnoDB buffer pool (MB)
editor.description: Main InnoDB cache. Roughly 50-70% of the RAM you intend this node to use.

editor.label: Galera cache (MB)
editor.description: Write-set cache. Bigger means a node that was offline for a while can catch up with a fast IST instead of a full state transfer.

configFiles.template:
# Extra MariaDB options for this node.
#
# Mounted into the container as /etc/mysql/conf.d/zz-custom.cnf, which MariaDB reads
# AFTER the TCAdmin-generated galera.cnf - so anything set here wins.
#
# Edit this file and restart the service to apply. Do not edit conf.d/galera.cnf:
# it is regenerated from config.json on every start.

[mysqld]

script.name: Backup MariaDB database
script.description: Lists databases and creates a MariaDB backup using temporary credential and shell files, with explicit success or failure output.

script.name: Restore MariaDB backup
script.description: Lists .sql and .sql.gz files in backups, asks for a file, confirms the destructive restore, and imports it into MariaDB.

script.name: Configure Galera node
script.description: Generates conf.d/galera.cnf from config.json, discovers the other cluster nodes, and lines the container network up with the addresses it advertises. Runs immediately before every start.

script.name: Bootstrap / recover cluster from this node
script.description: Restarts a cluster that is completely down, using this node's data as the starting point.

script.name: Force full resync (SST)
script.description: Wipes this node's data directory so the next start pulls a complete copy from a healthy node. Destructive.

script.name: Test peer connectivity
script.description: Probes every cluster address from inside this container, including this node's own published ports.
